name: Mines of Rammelsberg, Historic Town of Goslar and Upper Harz Water Management System
description: Rammelsberg is a mountain on the northern edge of Germany's Harz range, above the old town of Goslar in Lower Saxony. Its silver, copper and lead mine ran for over 1,000 years until it closed in 1988, and you can now tour it. To the south, medieval monks and later miners built a vast network of ponds, channels and tunnels that harnessed water to power the mines.
